_about: Everything specific to one league. build.py, audit.py, fetch_season.js and page.py read this; the code itself is shared.

espn._histBefore: Seasons before this year are read from ESPN's leagueHistory endpoint (and have no transaction log).

name: Brown Cow 3.0

cutoffs._seedsFrom: First season whose playoff seeds are shown and counted for upsets and 'from the No. N seed' headlines.
cutoffs._pprFrom: Lowest-score, lowest-winning-score and points-per-game records start here.

_losersLadder: 12 teams, 6-team playoff: wk1 7v8, 9v10, 11v12; wk2 W1vW2, L1vW3, L2vL3; last place is loser(L1vW3) vs loser(L2vL3). Simulated for Sacko odds only when true.

oneOffs._bridesmaid: Home-page 'Always a bridesmaid' card and the 'Nth runner-up finish' season headline (3+).

page.title: Brown Cow Almanac
page.tagline: Fifteen seasons, twelve seats, one very questionable painting. The league's record book.

art.alt: Folk painting of a big brown cow and its calf in a green valley under blue mountains, with a boy on a tree stump
art.caption: The league's patron saint

notes.footerGaps: ESPN keeps no weekly lineups for 2018–2019.
notes.recordsLede: Single-week marks use regular-season games, because the 2013–2018 playoff rounds ran two weeks. The lowest-score list starts in 2013, when the league went PPR.
notes.missedTail: No winning record has missed since 2019.
notes.timelineLede: Champions and every rule change ESPN recorded. Brown dots mark seasons where the format changed, which is why a 2015 score and a 2025 score don't compare one-to-one.
notes.footerSeats: Franchises that changed hands or added a co-manager are tracked as one seat.

site._about: Where this league is published: its folder in the repo ("" = repo root), public address, home-screen name and colors, and which repository secret holds its GroupMe bot ID.
